field.supervision: Original RGB at legal observed-road BUILD40 masks. No road_edit_rgb, hidden deleted-actor target, generated image or native residual colour used as GT.
field.caveat: HELD9 excludes only this residual solve; original frozen V2 proxy already used FRONT199. This is not strict world-patch blinding or prior validation.

geometry_alpha_invariance.unsaved_full49_scope: For non-keyframes full precision invariance cannot be independently reloaded; compare saved alpha/depth summaries/PNG and runtime declaration separately.

corridor_scope_check.scope_change: Persistent world active mask only; no image ROI, per-frame routing, geometry movement, sigma/opacity or material coefficient update.

new_depth_metric.name: observed_road_depth_m
new_depth_metric.reference: Original scene_depth_m: nearest actual projected LiDAR return per pixel; evaluated on obs road AND positive scene_depth_m.
new_depth_metric.render_semantics: Native Gaussian expected camera depth = sum_i(T_i*alpha_i*z_i)/sum_i(T_i*alpha_i), divided by meter_to_model. This is not first ray/surface intersection or nearest rendered surface depth.
new_depth_metric.comparison_caveat: Reference is a sparse first-return depth; mixed-layer expected depth can differ substantially. Report absolute residuals and sample counts; do not call this first-hit geometry accuracy.
new_depth_metric.gate: Descriptive metric newly introduced here, no retrospectively invented V1 preservation threshold; old receipts unchanged.

receipt.where: first raw105 keep baseline metrics; before any calibrated forward or quality score
receipt.count_basis: executed source order: extension solo then keep baseline; crash before subsequent variant
receipt.recovery: separate if variant!=baseline guard, unchanged method, rerun in results/pilot_worldfield_r2
